# Shipton's Big R

> > Comprehensive farm, ranch, and retail supply chain serving Montana and Wyoming with livestock equipment, tools, apparel, and outdoor gear from leading brands.

Shipton's Big R operates multiple locations across Montana and Wyoming, providing farm and ranch supplies alongside automotive, home improvement, sporting goods, and apparel. The store partners with major brands including Carhartt, Ariat, DeWalt, STIHL, and others to serve rural and agricultural communities.

## Key Topics

- Farm and Ranch Supplies
- Livestock Equipment
- Sporting Goods
- Apparel & Footwear
- Tools & Equipment
- Carhartt
- Ariat

- Home Improvement

- In-Store Services

## Product Categories

- [Products](https://shiptonsbigr.com/products): Main product catalog and department categories for all merchandise
- [Farm and Ranch Supplies](https://shiptonsbigr.com/farm-and-ranch): Farm & ranch supplies including livestock equipment and tack products
- [Pet and Animal Supplies](https://shiptonsbigr.com/pet-and-animal-supplies): Pet supplies, animal feed, fencing, and beekeeping products
- [Apparel & Footwear](https://shiptonsbigr.com/apparel-and-footwear): Apparel and footwear product catalog across MT & WY locations
- [Automotive and Hardware](https://shiptonsbigr.com/automotive-and-hardware): Automotive supplies, power tools, and hardware product selection
- [Sporting Goods](https://shiptonsbigr.com/sporting-goods): Sporting goods for hunting, fishing, camping and outdoor recreation
- [Home Improvement](https://shiptonsbigr.com/home-improvement-): Home improvement tools, fasteners, electrical supplies & generators
- [Lawn & Garden](https://shiptonsbigr.com/lawn-garden): Lawn & garden products including STIHL equipment and outdoor tools
- [Home Goods](https://shiptonsbigr.com/home-goods): Home goods including Pendleton wool products, candles & canning supplies
